beats.say: GTA 6 launches on 19 November 2026, but it's not what you'd expect.
Instead of chaotic mayhem, it promises a more grounded, realistic experience. PC Gamer says it won't come at the expense of the series' usual haphazard chaos.
Set in Leonida, a fictional US state based on Florida, it follows Jason and Lucia.
Their criminal adventures blend realism with the series' signature chaos.
Development began in 2020, building anticipation for fans worldwide.
This new direction could redefine the series for players like you.
Are you ready for a different kind of Grand Theft Auto adventure?

facts: Grand Theft Auto 6 is scheduled to be released on 19 November 2026 for the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.
The story follows a criminal couple named Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos.
Grand Theft Auto VI is set within the fictional US state of Leonida, based on Florida.
Principal production began in 2020 after early development started following Red Dead Redemption 2's release in 2018.
